name: CortexMind v4.0.0
body:
## CortexMind 4.0.0

**GPU acceleration everywhere.** Memory search now runs on the GPU on every platform: Metal on Apple Silicon, and any Vulkan-capable card on Linux and Windows, including NVIDIA, AMD and Intel Arc. Nothing extra to download: the inference engine ships inside the app.

**Picks the right device on its own.** On first launch CortexMind times your CPU against every GPU it can see and keeps the fastest. A GPU that would be slower than your CPU is never used. `memory_status` shows exactly which device each model is running on.

**Lighter on your machine.** About 2 GB of GPU memory when a GPU is in use, the reranker runs at full precision, and the first launch after upgrading removes the old model files, freeing several gigabytes of disk.

**Faster on Apple Silicon.** Memory search on an M-series Mac is roughly twice as fast as in 3.8.

Full changelog: https://cortexmind.net/changelog

Signed updater artifacts are attached. Existing installs update automatically.
